verdict.rationale: Cloud Firestore offers a MongoDB-compatible API, so existing MongoDB drivers, tools and integrations can connect to it. This is a first-party path for standard clients, but it is limited to the Firestore Enterprise edition, and connection-string usage and ORM support are not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit connection-string documentation, named ORM support (e.g. Mongoose or SQL ORMs), availability outside the Enterprise edition, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect to the underlying database with standard clients and ORMs via a connection string

citations.quote: Cloud Firestore offers a MongoDB-compatible API. You can use existing MongoDB application code, drivers, tools, and the open-source ecosystem of MongoDB integrations with Cloud Firestore in the Firestore Enterprise edition.
